snippet.title: Robber (異種入侵), Action, 2000, Micro Sova
snippet.description: It’s very rare action shooter from Taiwan. You are able to choice three different mechs in the beginning of gameplay. The graphics is colorful. Great thanks for Terje_P, who shared the game for us!
